settings.heading: Connect with #myflooret
settings.content: Our Instagram feed is a dynamic showcase of real homes with Flooret floors. Search for #myflooret to see how others have upgraded their spaces. From cozy bedrooms to elegant living areas, these are genuine makeovers that speak for themselves.

settings.heading: Show Us Your Style
settings.content: Have you installed Flooret in your home? Share your makeover with the #myflooret hashtag and add to the collective inspiration. Your design choices could be the guide someone else needs to make their decision.
